name: clean-highway-pay
about: A sound ad: a white tractor and van on a prairie highway at dusk, the pay on the kit's green plate below it. Our overlay over the checker's clean-highway photo.

truth.how: nothing planted: the subject is clear, the plate is the kit's green, the headline over the truck

subject_legible.reason: A white semi-truck and trailer on an open highway at sunset is immediately recognizable at a glance.

words_match_picture.reason: An OTR pay-per-mile headline sits over a classic long-haul truck on an open road, telling exactly one consistent story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The dark green panel anchors the bottom, making the large headline unmissable first and the bold 'Apply today' button clearly second, with no picture element competing.

looks_like_kit.reason: The deep dark-green panel (#0B3D2E) and white text match the brand colours exactly, though no logo is present to reinforce the carrier identity.
